articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg and his wife make an extravagant wish come true with billionaire money
articles.standfirst: Their latest purchase looks straight out of a fairy tale
articles.summary: Their latest purchase looks straight out of a fairy tale
articles.body:
T here comes a point when billionaire money can turn an almost childlike fantasy into something very real. For Mark Zuckerberg and his wife, Priscilla Chan , that now apparently means being able to say they have a castle of their own.

The Meta CEO and Chan have purchased Strancally Castle, a striking 19th-century Gothic Revival property in County Waterford, Ireland, according to multiple reports. A spokesperson for Zuckerberg has confirmed the acquisition, saying the family is excited to care for the historic home and spend time in Ireland. The price remains private, but the estate has been valued at between €20 million and €30 million roughly $23 million to $35 million.

And this is no mansion simply borrowing the word “castle.” Built around 1830, Strancally rises above the River Blackwater and sits within roughly 440 acres of countryside.

The three-story property has undergone extensive restoration over the past two decades, turning an aging piece of Irish history into the kind of secluded retreat that very few people in the world could ever call home.

Zuckerberg and Chan bought the estate from Michael and Giancarla Alen-Buckley, whose family had owned it for about 25 years . The former owners said they were leaving with fond memories after having the opportunity to save and restore the property, while expressing satisfaction that its new owners intend to continue investing in the house and grounds. The deal was completed privately and off-market several weeks ago.

The castle will not replace the couple's life in the United States. Instead, it is expected to become their home when spending time in Ireland, a country with a particularly important connection to Zuckerberg's business empire: Meta has its international headquarters in Dublin and employs around 1,500 people in the country.

Perhaps the most extraordinary part is that buying a castle is only the latest chapter in the couple's remarkable real-estate story. Zuckerberg and Chan have amassed extensive property in Hawaii, and earlier this year they were reported to have paid $170 million for a waterfront mansion on Miami's ultra-exclusive Indian Creek Island.

For most people, owning a castle belongs to childhood stories, movies or a dream that disappears somewhere along the way to adulthood. For Zuckerberg and Chan, extraordinary wealth has made that fantasy a set of keys.

Their new retreat comes with hundreds of acres, a river at its doorstep, and nearly two centuries of history, proving that when money is no longer an obstacle, even the most extravagant wishes can become reality.

articles.title: A man steps into the ring and faces a humanoid robot in a scene from another world
articles.body:
T here is no doubt that 2026 is showing just how quickly artificial intelligence and robotics are advancing . Humanoid robots have moved beyond demonstrations limited to standing, walking or performing simple movements. Now, they are starring in increasingly striking scenes.

One of them took place during the 2026 World Robot Conference in Beijing , where different companies showcased their latest developments and demonstrated just how far these machines can go.

What happened during the demonstration?

A man stepped into the ring and faced a humanoid robot in a sparring session in front of conference attendees , creating a scene that looked like something out of an intense dream.

Inside the ring, the two exchanged punches while the robot responded to the movements of the person standing in front of it.

But is this really something new?

Not exactly. Robots fighting is not a completely new sight . In 2025, several demonstrations began gaining attention as machines faced each other inside a ring.

Humanoid robots had also been seen performing martial arts moves, acrobatics and exercises designed to showcase their balance and coordination.

However, the images from Beijing introduce an important change: this time, the opponent was not another robot, but a person.

How often is the World Robot Conference held?

The World Robot Conference takes place every year in August, bringing together new developments and existing technologies from the world of robotics. People from different countries can also attend and participate in the event .

articles.title: Galaxy S26: 3 camera features you need to know to get the most out of your phone
articles.standfirst: The phone has more than one hidden surprise.
articles.summary: The phone has more than one hidden surprise.
articles.body:
The Galaxy S26 continues to get attention from users and, beyond the features that usually get the most attention , its camera hides several tools that can change the way you use the phone. Finding them simply requires exploring a few settings and options that aren't always easy to spot.

Among them are four features worth knowing. Each serves a different purpose, from getting better results when taking photos to having more control when recording videos , plus an option that can be especially useful in everyday situations.

24 MP: an option right in the middle

Let's start with one of the features that can be easiest to overlook: 24 MP mode.

The Galaxy S26 offers 12 MP and 50 MP options, but there's also this middle-ground alternative that aims to combine the best of both . Through AI Fusion processing, the phone uses higher-resolution information and computational photography techniques to produce images with more detail than 12 MP shots, without reaching the file size of a 50 MP photo.

The catch? It isn't immediately visible.

To use it, you need to download Good Lock from the Galaxy Store and install the Camera Assistant module. Then, go into the camera settings, turn on the 24 MP option and return to Photo mode .

The 24M option will then appear.

It's an interesting alternative if you want a little more detail in your photos without having every image take up as much storage space as a 50 MP shot.

Virtual Reflector lets you play with light

The second feature takes a completely different approach.

Virtual Reflector has nothing to do with photo resolution. Instead, it focuses on something that can make a huge difference in the final result: lighting .

The tool allows you to virtually adjust the color, intensity and direction of the light reflected onto the subject. The idea is based on something photographers often do with physical reflectors, but here the adjustment is handled directly through software .

To find it, open Expert RAW, Samsung's app for users who want greater control over their photos. The Virtual Reflector option can be found in the Labs section, where you can experiment with the lighting.

And this is where the Galaxy S26's camera starts offering something different: instead of simply taking a photo and accepting the way the light looks, you have more options for adjusting it .

Horizontal Lock keeps your videos from looking tilted

Now let's move on to video.

The Galaxy S26 also features Horizontal Lock, a tool found within Super Steady that aims to keep the horizon level while recording.

The feature uses the phone's motion sensors to detect how you're moving and keep the frame as level as possible. That means the horizon can remain steady even if you tilt or rotate the phone while recording.

To activate it, open Video, select Super Steady and look for the horizontal lock icon.

There is one detail to keep in mind: Horizontal Lock requires good lighting conditions to work. If the environment is too dark, the feature may not be available .

For anyone who records while walking, follows moving subjects or simply wants steadier videos without using additional accessories, it can be a very practical tool.

articles.title: Elon Musk warns about the change mobile phones will undergo before 2030
articles.standfirst: Artificial intelligence will be key in this project
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence will be key in this project
articles.body:
Elon Musk, among his multiple projects, would have the manufacture of a mobile phone powered by artificial intelligence (AI) , a rumor that began last year, 2025, but which is still not underway, as he himself explained on the podcast "Joe Rogan Experience".'

For the moment, he assured that manufacturing will not begin "unless necessary", since he does not want to launch a mobile phone onto the market, but rather "a way that is very different from the most traditional sense of what a mobile phone is".

'“We will not have a mobile phone in the traditional sense. What we will call a phone will actually be a peripheral node for AI inference with wireless connections. The artificial intelligence on the server will communicate with the AI on your device and generate real-time video of anything you can imagine" , was his explanation.'

Elon Musk's estimate for being able to begin its development

And this device would not be subject to operating systems or applications; it will only have a screen and audio, with AI and the human as the central focus: "Anything you can think of, or really anything AI can anticipate you might want, it will show you. Probably within five or six years."

He already presented this idea at a Neuralink event, in 2025 : “In the future, physical devices such as smartphones will be obsolete,” he stated, since everything will go through implants and AI: “In a few years, these implants will be safe and advanced enough to be adopted on a massive scale”.

He wants to create people directly connected with technology, something that began in January 2024, when Neuralink achieved a technological milestone by implanting its first brain chip in Noland Arbaugh, who had quadriplegia after an accident in 2016.

Thanks to this device, Arbaugh regained digital autonomy by controlling a computer with his mind, even being able to play video games.

articles.title: ChatGPT goes silent as 74,000 outage reports pour in and OpenAI works on a fix
articles.standfirst: Complaints exploded within 30 minutes as elevated errors affected both ChatGPT and Codex
articles.summary: Complaints exploded within 30 minutes as elevated errors affected both ChatGPT and Codex
articles.body:
For a platform designed to answer almost any question, the most frustrating one Thursday morning was also the simplest: Is ChatGPT down? For tens of thousands of users, the chatbot could not even respond.

Reports began climbing at extraordinary speed. More than 5,000 problems had been reported to Downdetector by 7:53 a.m. PT. Ten minutes later, that number had surpassed 22,000. By 8:23 a.m., more than 74,000 reports had poured in.

OpenAI’s status page initially showed no known problems, even as complaints spread online and searches for “Is ChatGPT down?” began trending. At 7:58 a.m. PT, the company officially acknowledged “elevated errors” affecting both ChatGPT and Codex, its AI coding service.

OpenAI applies mitigation as users wait for recovery

At 8:22 a.m. PT, OpenAI announced that it had applied a mitigation and was monitoring the recovery . The incident page listed 15 affected ChatGPT components and four Codex components, although the disruption did not appear to be a complete shutdown for every user.

That helps explain why some people could still access ChatGPT while others encountered failed prompts, slow responses or a service that would not load at all. Large online platforms can suffer partial or intermittent failures that affect particular regions, accounts or features without taking the entire system offline.

The gap between the first user complaints and OpenAI’s acknowledgment is also not necessarily unusual. Downdetector reacts immediately to sudden increases in public reports, while a company must first detect, verify and classify an incident before changing its official status page. Its figures represent submitted reports, not a confirmed count of every person affected.

OpenAI has not yet explained what went wrong or confirmed that the problem is completely over . But the reaction said plenty: ChatGPT has become part of how people work, study and get through their day and when it suddenly goes silent, they feel its absence immediately.

articles.title: Bill Gates, businessman: “It’s fine to celebrate success, but it is more important to pay attention to the lessons of failure”
articles.standfirst: Bill Gates reflects on failure and learning. Learn the meaning of his famous quote and how it relates to his career at Microsoft
articles.summary: Bill Gates reflects on failure and learning. Learn the meaning of his famous quote and how it relates to his career at Microsoft
articles.body:
Success can become a celebration, but also a distraction if it prevents looking at what went wrong. For Bill Gates , businessman and co-founder of Microsoft , mistakes have a value that often remains hidden behind great triumphs.

“ It’s fine to celebrate success, but it is more important to pay attention to the lessons of failure ,” is one of the phrases that sums up that perspective. The idea becomes especially compelling when remembering that even one of the most influential figures in computing acknowledges decisions that, over time, he would have made differently.

What does this Bill Gates quote mean?

Gates's reflection suggests that making mistakes does not necessarily mean the end of a project, but rather an opportunity to identify what could have been done better. Success, on the other hand, can build confidence, but it does not always force people to question the decisions that were made.

The businessman himself has spoken about some of his biggest professional mistakes. One of them was not having anticipated the potential of mobile telephony in time, an area in which Microsoft lost ground to companies like Apple and the Android ecosystem.

His experience also shows that setbacks do not disappear after having achieved major goals. Gates has pointed out that, when facing difficulties, it is important to avoid panic and use what happened to learn and correct course. Among the main ideas that can be drawn from the phrase are:

Failure can become learning.

Success does not guarantee that all decisions are correct.

Recognizing mistakes allows you to make better decisions.

The ability to adapt is essential in the face of change.

Who is Bill Gates and what did he do?

William Henry Gates III was born in Seattle, United States, in 1955. From a young age, he showed an interest in programming and, together with Paul Allen , began developing software for the first microcomputers.

In 1975 they both founded Microsoft . The company secured an agreement with IBM to provide an operating system for its personal computers. Microsoft marketed MS-DOS and later drove the development of Windows , whose version 3.1, released in 1992, achieved enormous popularity.

Bill Gates dropped out of Harvard to devote himself to his business venture. With the growth of Microsoft he became one of the richest and most influential businessmen in the world and, later, focused much of his activity on philanthropy.

The phrase thus takes on another dimension: behind a path marked by great successes, there are also mistaken decisions. For Bill Gates , facing those mistakes head-on could be precisely what makes it possible to avoid repeating them and to find new opportunities.

articles.title: Larry Page, founder of Google: “When you aim for the stars, you may not reach them, but you’ll still make it to the moon”
articles.standfirst: On this day 28 years ago, Google was founded
articles.summary: On this day 28 years ago, Google was founded
articles.body:
Objectives and goals are something necessary throughout our lives. They are the things that make us focus on a task, on an exercise, on a motivation. On September 4, 1998, Larry Page became someone who had achieved his goal, although perhaps at that moment he still did not know it .

Google is a technology company and the most popular search engine in the world . Larry Page is a co-founder of the company, which began as a university project. Page, together with his friend Sergey Brin, started this idea at Stanford University . In fact, at first the search engine had another name, BackRub, but one day they decided to change it to the one we know today, Google. The name refers to the mathematical term “googol,” which is equivalent to 10 raised to the power of 100. With this, they wanted to reflect their goal of organizing all the information that existed on the internet.

His project did not succeed overnight; it required effort and resilience . To talk about those values, Page said the famous quote: “When you aim for the stars, you may not reach them, but you will still get to the moon” . With this phrase, the businessman wants to express that we should always aim as high as possible, whether in our jobs, in our relationships, or in life in general. We may not achieve the utmost, but trying is the way to get there, or at least, to stay close .

Perseverance, a key factor in achieving success

Google's trajectory is a good example of that idea. What began as an academic project between two students ended up becoming one of the most important technology companies in the world . Along the way, Page and Brin had to face difficulties, make risky decisions, and stay committed to an idea whose potential was not always obvious. Perseverance was , therefore, a fundamental part of a success that today seems almost inevitable in hindsight.

Page's quote also highlights the importance of not giving up when results do not come immediately. Setting ambitious goals can serve as a guide for moving forward, even when the final outcome does not match initial expectations . In that sense, failure does not have to mean the end of the road, but can instead become an opportunity to learn, correct mistakes, and keep moving toward new goals. For the founder of Google, aiming high does not guarantee reaching the stars, but it can take us much farther than we would have imagined.

articles.title: Steve Jobs, entrepreneur: "We're here to make a dent in the universe. Otherwise, why else are we here?"
articles.standfirst: The Apple co-founder died in October 2011 from pancreatic cancer
articles.summary: The Apple co-founder died in October 2011 from pancreatic cancer
articles.body:
S teve Jobs ' belief in the power of innovation inspires professionals feeling lost, proving that embracing change fosters profound personal and career development.

The Apple co-founder revolutionized technology through a bold vision of modern progress. Facing constant social comparison and career uncertainty today, the American leader's philosophy becomes increasingly relevant. His insights encourage individuals to rediscover direction and purpose when navigating the complex challenges of a hyperconnected and fast-paced digital world.

Furthermore, the fear of making mistakes often stifles creative talent across many industries.

Xcessive pressure for hyperproductivity frequently causes widespread professional burnout. Jobs' dedication to passion demonstrates that taking calculated risks remains essential for achieving transformative success and resilience in any meaningful and long-term career endeavor.

Technological Innovation as a Tool for Transforming the Modern World

Jobs built his legacy by creating products centered entirely on human user experience. His focus on elegant design and intuitive functionality revolutionized entire global industries, including computing, music, and mobile telecommunications. He successfully introduced iconic devices that permanently altered daily consumer habits and communication patterns worldwide.

His famous quote invites everyone to make a positive impact within their respective fields. In today's competitive digital environment, this philosophy inspires modern entrepreneurs to pursue projects with genuine purpose. Creating meaningful contributions for society remains the most reliable pathway toward achieving authentic and lasting professional significance.

articles.standfirst: What does Steve Jobs' quote about perseverance mean? Learn his advice for entrepreneurs
articles.summary: What does Steve Jobs' quote about perseverance mean? Learn his advice for entrepreneurs
articles.body:
Building a company from scratch means going through moments of uncertainty, mistakes, and decisions that can test even the most promising ideas. For Steve Jobs , co-founder of Apple, one of the differences between those who manage to move forward and those who give up lies in the ability to remain steadfast in the face of difficulties.

“I’m convinced that half of what separates successful entrepreneurs from unsuccessful ones is pure perseverance,” Jobs said while reflecting on the entrepreneurial journey. His own path was marked by setbacks, including his departure from Apple in 1985, before returning to the company more than a decade later.

What does this Steve Jobs quote mean?

The phrase suggests that a good idea, talent, or financial resources are not always enough to build a business. For Jobs , perseverance makes it possible to keep working on a project even when results do not appear immediately.

His story serves as an example. After leaving Apple, Jobs founded NeXT and acquired a company that would later become Pixar . Apple bought NeXT in 1997, which allowed his return to the company and opened a new stage of innovation.

Therefore, persevering does not mean endlessly repeating a strategy that does not work, but rather maintaining a vision while learning, correcting mistakes, and finding new ways to achieve the goal.

Steve Jobs' Advice for Entrepreneurs

Based on his career and the ideas associated with his business philosophy, some of Jobs's main lessons are:

Work with passion and find what truly motivates you.

Trust your intuition, especially when exploring new paths.

Observe and learn from different disciplines and experiences.

Surround yourself with talented people capable of complementing your own skills.

Believing in ideas, even when they initially seem risky.

Learning from failures instead of interpreting them as the end.

Seek quality and pay attention to detail.

These ideas were related to the way Steve Jobs understood innovation: it was not only about creating technology, but about building products and experiences capable of changing people's relationship with it.

What are Steve Jobs' 7 principles?

"In the book The Innovation Secrets of Steve Jobs , Carmine Gallo identifies seven principles associated with the entrepreneur's philosophy of innovation:

Make a dent in the universe.

Sell dreams, not products.

Say no to a thousand things.

Create incredibly great experiences.

Taken together, these Steve Jobs' principles summarize a philosophy that combines passion, vision, creativity, simplicity, and communication. More than formulas to guarantee success, they work as ideas for rethinking the way of undertaking.

Steve Jobs's career shows that even the most renowned projects go through complicated moments. In a business environment where technologies and markets are constantly changing, his reflection on perseverance remains relevant: the next great ideas will also need people willing to work for them when the path becomes difficult.

articles.title: Everything Apple announced at keynote event: Way more than just the iPhone Duo
articles.standfirst: Apple is releasing two new phones, two new watches, and a new audio product.
articles.summary: Apple is releasing two new phones, two new watches, and a new audio product.
articles.body:
Every September, the hype begins building for a fresh new slate of upcoming products set to be released by Apple . Without fail, this year's keynote presentation was no different.

Dubbed " Surprise and Shine ", the event was a rousing success - at least for Apple fans. Five new products were announced , with all five taking up plenty of time during the presentation. Features and release dates were revealed, and it won't be long before tech enthusiasts can get their hands on all of it.

Apple reveals iPhone Duo, their first foldable phone

The top product and most-anticipated one in the new lineup was the iPhone Duo . The Duo is Apple's first foldable phone , one that's been in the works for a long time. Apple fell behind other major phone manufacturers in this space, but the Duo is finally arriving to rival the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 and others.

The Duo is expected to release on October 23 . Pre-orders begin one week prior. It will come in two colors, Star White and Night Sky. The entry point 256GB version will retail for $1,999 , while the max 2TB version will cost a whopping $3,199 .

iPhone 18 Pro keeps similar design, upgrades internals

While the Duo stole the show, the iPhone 18 Pro will be the true seller for Apple in the grand scheme of things. The 18 Pro is stated to have much better battery life and performance with its A20 Pro chip than the 17 Pro. The new camera system will also feature a variable aperture lens.

The iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders begin on September 12 , with the phone's full release coming on September 18 . There will be a standard 6.3 inch display model, as well as the 6.9 inch Pro Max edition. The four available colors are Burgundy, Glacier, Silver, and Black. Pricing will begin at $1,199 for the base model and go up to $2,399 for the 2TB version. The Pro Max will cost $100 more across the board.

Apple updates both the Watch Ultra and regular Watch Series

It wasn't just the iPhones getting updated this time around. The Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 were both announced. Both have added more health and quality of life features. Both will be available for purchase starting on September 18 . The Series 12 will be available in a Ceramic finish option.

Apple updates their earbuds line with the AirPods 5

It might not be as flashy as the AirPods Pro line, but the AirPods 4 marked a major breakthrough for the earphones that sit outside of the ear without silicone tips, adding ANC in what many considered a more comfortable form factor.

The AirPods 5 are set to take things up a notch, with Apple claiming that this version will cancel noise up to 1.5 times better than the previous generation. The sound is set to be much improved, as well. There will be two versions, both with ANC: AirPods 5 for $129 and AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case for $149 . The more expensive option gives you slightly improved battery life. They will be available for purchase on September 18 .

articles.title: IShowSpeed steals Apple’s iPhone Duo launch with history-making backflip in front of CEO
articles.standfirst: Speed turned Apple’s carefully controlled event into his own euphoric show while holding the company’s first foldable iPhone
articles.summary: Speed turned Apple’s carefully controlled event into his own euphoric show while holding the company’s first foldable iPhone
articles.body:
A pple waited years to unveil its first foldable iPhone. IShowSpeed needed only a few seconds to find something nobody else had done with it.

Standing in front of new Apple CEO John Ternus and holding the brand-new iPhone Duo , the 21-year-old streamer suddenly decided that simply testing the device was not enough. He wanted to make history or at least create the first viral moment of Apple’s new era.

IShowSpeed flips while holding Apple’s first foldable iPhone

“But wait, I gotta be the first person to do a backflip holding an iPhone Duo,” Speed said as the idea entered his mind in real time. “Chat, we should make history right now.”

Moments later, Speed launched himself backward, completed a full rotation and landed safely without dropping Apple’s most expensive new iPhone . The room erupted as he celebrated becoming, by his own declaration, the first person to perform a backflip while holding an iPhone Duo.

“First person,” he shouted before turning the stunt into a perfect joke about the phone’s defining feature. “I flipped. I flipped the iPhone.”

Ternus could only watch as Speed transformed what is normally a carefully controlled Apple demonstration into something chaotic, spontaneous and unmistakably his. After completing the stunt, Speed casually looked at the CEO and asked: “All right, John. Do you want your phone back?”

The moment brought together two completely different worlds. Apple had just introduced a $1,999 device designed to represent the future of its most important product. Speed immediately treated it like a prop in one of his livestreams and somehow gave the iPhone Duo one of its first unforgettable demonstrations.

Apple’s foldable phone features a 7.6-inch interior display, a 5.4-inch exterior screen, the A20 Pro chip and support for the Apple Pencil. It can run two applications side by side and is scheduled to arrive in stores on October 23.

Speed’s day became even more surreal when he met New Orleans Pelicans star DeAndre Jordan live on stream. The 6-foot-11 center admitted he wanted the new foldable iPhone Duo for one simple reason: his hands are too big for a regular phone.

Foldable phones have existed for years, but Apple’s arrival could finally push the category into the mainstream. Before that happens, however, IShowSpeed has already claimed a tiny piece of iPhone history in the most IShowSpeed way possible: by risking a $2,000 phone, flying backward through the air and turning directly to his audience to celebrate-

articles.title: Bill Gates’ disturbing AI prediction paints a frightening picture of what could come next
articles.standfirst: The co-founder of Microsoft has raised major alarms just as AI experts warn about humankind's future.
articles.summary: The co-founder of Microsoft has raised major alarms just as AI experts warn about humankind's future.
articles.body:
At this point, it's quite ironic to hear tech moguls speak out on the dangers of AI. After all, they have been and continue to be part of the problem. That's why when Bill Gates sounds the alarm on our future with AI, it comes with some reservations from many.

But Gates' heart seems to be in the right place, for the most part. This past weekend, he once again tried to warn the world about what could be set to come in the near future, unless the AI wave is slowed down in some capacity . Gates didn't just raise the alarm; he sounded it from the very top of the highest mountain.

While speaking at the Telluride Film Festival , Gates followed up his 6,000 word essay on the topic of AI's inherent risks with another eye-opening speech. In it, Gates wondered aloud if this is now "the greatest problem humanity has ever faced" . Gates believes the experts in the AI space, as well as political leaders, are not preparing adequately for what could end up leading to a massive loss of jobs in the world.

The 3 jobs Bill Gates opines should be safe from AI for a while

Not every job is going to be rendered obsolete by AI, though. Gates has predicted three particular jobs that should be safe from the quick advent of AI ; at least for now.

Coders: " AI will need human coders to evolve. If you’re in tech, you’re not out of the game. "

Energy Experts: “ Would you trust AI to run a nuclear reactor? Didn’t think so. ”

Biologists: " AI can process data. But it takes a human to make the breakthrough. "

That should quell fears for some people, but Gates' overall point is terrifying: Millions, if not billions, of people are going to lose their job potentially within a decade, and there's no clear pivot at this moment in time .
